preconditions.expression: T == int(T) and T >= 1 and T <= 100
preconditions.description: T is an integer between 1 and 100 inclusive, representing the number of test cases.

preconditions.expression: all(N == int(N) and M == int(M) and K == int(K) and 1 <= N <= 70 and 1 <= M <= 70 and 1 <= K <= 70 for N, M, K in [line.split() for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:T+1]])
preconditions.description: For each test case, N, M, and K are integers between 1 and 70 inclusive, representing grid dimensions and number of paths.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '\n'.join(str(minimize_max_stones(N, M, K)) for N, M, K in [tuple(map(int, line.split())) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:T+1]]) + '\n'
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output is the smallest possible value of S (maximum stones in any cell) when K paths are chosen optimally.
